title: Definitions - Buildings
content: Buildings means the home, its garages and permanent outbuildings, fixed fuel tanks, swimming pools, tennis courts, terraces, patios, drives, footpaths, walls, gates and fences, all at the address shown in the schedule. Buildings does not include land, trees, hedges, plants or lawns.

title: Definitions - Contents
content: Contents means household goods, personal property and valuables owned by you or your family and normally kept in the home. Contents does not include motor vehicles, watercraft, aircraft, livestock, or property held for business or trade purposes.

title: Definitions - Storm
content: Storm means violent wind, usually accompanied by rain, hail or snow, with wind speeds of at least 55 miles per hour, or rainfall exceeding 25 millimetres per hour, or snow falling to a depth exceeding 30 centimetres in 24 hours. A period of persistent rain without violent wind is not a storm.

title: Buildings - Storm or flood
content: We will pay for loss or damage to the buildings caused by storm or flood. The standard excess of GBP 350 applies to each claim under this section. Cover under this clause is subject to the exclusions in Section 5.

title: Buildings - Falling trees, branches, aerials and satellite dishes
content: We will pay for loss or damage to the buildings caused by falling trees or branches, television or radio aerials, satellite dishes and their fittings and masts. We will not pay for damage caused by trees or branches that are felled, lopped or topped by you or on your instruction, nor for the cost of removing the fallen tree or branch unless it has caused damage to the buildings. The standard excess of GBP 350 applies.

title: Buildings - Escape of water
content: We will pay for loss or damage to the buildings caused by water escaping from fixed water tanks, apparatus, pipes, washing machines, dishwashers or fixed heating systems. An increased excess of GBP 500 applies to each escape of water claim. We will not pay for damage caused by water escaping over a period of time from a defect you knew about or ought reasonably to have known about.

title: Buildings - Trace and access
content: Following a claim covered under Section 2.3 Escape of water, we will pay the reasonable costs of removing and replacing any part of the buildings necessary to find the source of the escape of water and to repair it. Our liability under this trace and access clause is limited to GBP 5,000 for any one claim. This limit is included within, and not in addition to, the buildings sum insured.

title: Buildings - Subsidence, heave and landslip
content: We will pay for loss or damage to the buildings caused by subsidence or heave of the site on which the buildings stand, or landslip. An excess of GBP 1,000 applies to each subsidence, heave or landslip claim. We will not pay for damage to drives, footpaths, patios, walls, gates, fences, swimming pools or tennis courts unless the home itself is damaged at the same time and by the same cause.

title: Contents - Accidental damage
content: If accidental damage cover is shown as operative in your schedule, we will pay for accidental damage to the contents occurring in the home. The standard excess of GBP 250 applies. Accidental damage cover does not extend to damage caused by wear and tear, or by any gradually operating cause.

title: Contents - Valuables sub-limit
content: Our liability for valuables is limited in total to one third of the contents sum insured. Our liability for any one article, collection or set of valuables is limited to GBP 2,500 unless that item is specified individually in your schedule. Valuables means jewellery, watches, furs, precious metals, works of art, collections of stamps, coins or medals.

title: General exclusions - Wear, tear and gradual deterioration
content: We will not pay for loss or damage caused by wear and tear, rust, corrosion, rot, fungus, mould, damp, insects, vermin, or any gradually operating cause. We will not pay for the cost of maintenance or for repairing a defect that existed before the period of insurance began.

title: General exclusions - Faulty workmanship and design
content: We will not pay for loss or damage arising from faulty or defective design, materials or workmanship, nor the cost of correcting such a fault or defect. Where faulty workmanship causes subsequent damage to other undamaged parts of the buildings, that subsequent damage may be covered if it results from an insured peril.

title: General exclusions - Unoccupied property
content: We will not pay for loss or damage caused by escape of water, theft, attempted theft, malicious damage or vandalism occurring while the home has been unoccupied for more than 45 consecutive days. Unoccupied means not lived in by you, your family or a person authorised by you.

title: General exclusions - Business use
content: We will not pay for loss, damage or liability arising from any business, profession or trade carried out at the home, other than clerical office work carried out by you. Stock, tools and equipment held for business purposes are not covered.

title: Conditions - Notification of claims
content: You must notify us of any incident that may give rise to a claim as soon as reasonably possible, and in any event within 30 days of the incident. Where notification is made later than 30 days, we may reduce or decline the claim to the extent that the delay has prejudiced our position, for example by preventing inspection of the damage or recovery from a third party.

title: Conditions - Reasonable care and mitigation
content: You must take reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep the buildings and contents in a good state of repair. Following an incident you must take reasonable steps to prevent further damage. We will pay the reasonable cost of emergency measures taken to prevent further damage, up to GBP 1,000, without applying a separate excess.

title: Endorsement HE-14 - Flood exclusion for listed postcodes
content: Where endorsement HE-14 is shown as operative in your schedule, Section 2.1 is amended so that loss or damage caused by flood is excluded. Damage caused by storm remains covered. This endorsement applies to risks in designated high flood risk postcodes and cannot be removed mid-term.

title: Definitions - Use classes
content: Social, domestic and pleasure use means use for social, domestic and pleasure purposes only, including commuting to a single permanent place of work if shown in your certificate. It excludes use for hire or reward, the carriage of goods for payment, courier or food delivery work, driving instruction for payment, and use in connection with the motor trade.

title: Section A - Loss or damage to your vehicle
content: If comprehensive cover is shown in your schedule, we will pay for loss of or damage to your vehicle caused by accident, fire, theft or attempted theft, or malicious damage. We will pay the cost of repair, or the market value of the vehicle immediately before the loss if that is less. The policy excess shown in your schedule applies to each claim.

title: Section A - Windscreen damage
content: We will pay for the repair or replacement of broken glass in your vehicle's windscreen, sunroof or windows, and for scratching of bodywork caused solely by the breakage. A windscreen excess of GBP 100 applies to replacement and GBP 25 to repair. A windscreen-only claim will not affect your no claim discount.

title: Section B - Liability to third parties
content: We will indemnify you against legal liability for death of or bodily injury to any person, and for damage to third party property, arising out of the use of your vehicle on a road or other public place. Our liability for third party property damage is limited to GBP 20,000,000 for any one claim or series of claims arising from one event. Cover for death or bodily injury is unlimited.

title: Section B - Legal defence costs
content: We will pay legal costs and expenses incurred with our written consent in defending any claim covered under Section 3.1, including the cost of representation at any coroner's inquest, fatal accident inquiry or court of summary jurisdiction. These costs are payable in addition to the limits of indemnity in Section 3.1.

title: Section C - Courtesy car
content: Where your vehicle is repaired by an approved repairer following a claim covered under Section A, we will provide a small hatchback courtesy car for the duration of the repair. A courtesy car is not provided where your vehicle is stolen and not recovered, or where it is declared a total loss.

title: General exclusions - Use not permitted by the certificate
content: We will not provide cover under any section while your vehicle is being used for a purpose not permitted by your certificate of motor insurance. Where a vehicle insured for social, domestic and pleasure use is used for hire or reward, including food or parcel delivery, cover under Section A is excluded. Cover under Section B is maintained only to the minimum extent required by road traffic legislation, and we reserve the right to recover from you any sum we are obliged to pay.

title: General exclusions - Driver not entitled
content: We will not provide cover while your vehicle is being driven by any person not described in your certificate as entitled to drive, or by any person who is disqualified from driving or has never held a licence to drive the vehicle.

title: General exclusions - Wear, tear and mechanical breakdown
content: We will not pay for wear and tear, depreciation, mechanical, electrical, electronic or computer breakdown or failure, or damage to tyres caused by braking, punctures, cuts or bursts.

title: Conditions - Credit hire and mitigation
content: Where you hire a replacement vehicle on credit terms following an accident, you must notify us before entering into the agreement. We will not pay credit hire charges that are unreasonable in duration or daily rate, or that exceed the cost of a comparable vehicle obtained through our own replacement vehicle service. You must take reasonable steps to mitigate the period of hire.

title: Definitions - Limit of indemnity
content: Limit of indemnity means the maximum amount we will pay, as shown in the schedule, in respect of any one occurrence or series of occurrences arising out of one event. For products liability the limit applies in the aggregate for all claims during the period of insurance.

title: Public liability - Indemnity
content: We will indemnify the insured against all sums which the insured becomes legally liable to pay as damages in respect of accidental bodily injury to any person, or accidental loss of or damage to material property, occurring during the period of insurance and arising out of the business. The limit of indemnity for public liability is GBP 5,000,000 for any one occurrence.

title: Public liability - Defence costs
content: We will in addition pay claimants' costs and expenses, and all costs and expenses incurred with our written consent in defending any claim. Defence costs are payable in addition to the limit of indemnity stated in Section 2.1, provided that where a payment exceeding the limit of indemnity has to be made to dispose of a claim, our liability for costs is limited to the proportion that the limit of indemnity bears to the amount paid.

title: Public liability - Occupiers duty and premises
content: Cover under Section 2.1 extends to the insured's liability as occupier of the premises stated in the schedule, including liability arising from the condition of floors, stairways and access ways. The insured must maintain a documented inspection and cleaning regime for customer areas. The policy excess for public liability claims is GBP 2,500 each and every claim including costs.

title: Employers liability - Indemnity
content: We will indemnify the insured against all sums which the insured becomes legally liable to pay as damages in respect of bodily injury sustained by any employee arising out of and in the course of employment by the insured in connection with the business. The limit of indemnity for employers liability is GBP 10,000,000 for any one occurrence inclusive of costs.

title: General exclusions - Deliberate acts and known defects
content: We will not indemnify the insured in respect of liability arising from any deliberate act or omission by the insured where injury or damage was the expected or intended result, nor from any defect or hazard of which the insured was aware and failed to remedy within a reasonable period.

title: General exclusions - Contractual liability
content: We will not indemnify the insured against liability assumed under contract or agreement which would not have attached in the absence of such contract or agreement.

title: Conditions - Claims control and admissions
content: The insured must not admit liability, offer or promise payment, or settle any claim without our written consent. The insured must forward to us immediately every letter of claim, claim form, summons or other legal process. Failure to comply may entitle us to reduce the claim payment to the extent we have been prejudiced.

title: Conditions - Risk improvement - wet floor management
content: It is a condition precedent to liability under Section 2.3 that where a floor surface in a customer area becomes wet, the insured places conspicuous warning signage at the affected area and records the time of placement and removal in a cleaning log. Failure to comply in respect of a specific incident entitles us to decline that claim.
